_note: A launch's flight on a curve (Game Design's fight-feel.md section 1; rulings-2026-10-19.md 1, 19b 4d; sim/core/flight.gd; docs/architecture/feel-core.md). The curve paces the body along the path its launch gave it: where it goes and lands are unchanged, only how fast he travels along it.
_enabled: the one switch. SimCore.newMatch copies it into S.flightOn unless the match's setup has its own "flight". Off: no flight state, no flight cue, and this file is not read into a replay

curve._note: live ticks after the send, and shares of the send's peak speed: the kick ramps from 0 to the peak over ramp ticks and holds it for hold; the glide eases to glide of the peak by easeTo, then holds; arrivals ramp to arrive of the peak over the last arriveTicks before his contact

pace._note: the most and the least his physics may be sped up or slowed in a tick to show the curve: near the top of a steep send he slows into the apex rather than leaping through it
